particles_path.description: .npz with 'samples' (N, ...) float and exactly one of 'log_weights' (N,) or 'weights' (N,); weights are normalised before resampling; memory grows as N^2 x (sample size) float64 per integration step, so keep N to a few thousand

a.description: Mean-reverting coefficient of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reference process; must be negative (more negative = faster mixing towards the empirical Gaussian reference); default -2 from demos/gaussian_mixture.ipynb (gms experiments use -1)

T.description: Terminal diffusion time T > 0; ts = linspace(0, T, nsteps + 1) as in every upstream caller; default 1.0 from the demo notebook

nsteps.description: Number of integration steps K >= 1; default 32 from the demo notebook

integrator.description: Integrator of the reverse dynamics; 'diffrax' (diffrax Euler solver) requires ode=True and 'tweedie' requires ode=False; default 'euler' from the upstream signature (the demo notebook uses 'jentzen_and_kloeden')

ode.description: True: probability-flow ODE (deterministic given the initial reference draw); False: reverse SDE; default True from the upstream signature

jitter.description: Non-negative value added to the reference variances for numerical stability (e.g. a dimension with zero weighted variance); upstream default 0

seed.description: Seed for jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); ignored when prng_key is given

prng_key.description: Optional raw PRNG key (two uint32 values) used instead of seed, e.g. to reproduce a run with a split key

output_dir.description: Base output directory; a fresh unique subdirectory is created per call (default <project>/tmp/outputs/<tool>)

particles_path.description: .npz with 'samples' (N, ...) float ((N,) or (N, d) for ensemble_ot and gumbel_softmax) and exactly one of 'log_weights' (N,) or 'weights' (N,); weights are normalised before resampling; ensemble_ot and gumbel_softmax build N x N arrays, so keep N to a few thousand

eps.description: ensemble_ot only: entropic regularisation > 0; None uses the upstream default 1/log(N)

alpha.description: soft only: softening parameter in [0, 1] (1 = multinomial); None uses 0.5, the experiments/gms/soft.py default (the paper's Gaussian-mixture table reports alpha = 0.9)

tau.description: gumbel_softmax only: temperature > 0 (-> 0 approaches multinomial); None uses 0.5, the experiments/gms/gumbel.py default (the paper's Gaussian-mixture table reports tau = 0.1)

seed.description: Seed for jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); ignored when prng_key is given

prng_key.description: Optional raw PRNG key (two uint32 values) used instead of seed, e.g. to reproduce a run with a split key

output_dir.description: Base output directory; a fresh unique subdirectory is created per call (default <project>/tmp/outputs/<tool>)
